visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short, black hair and glasses, wearing a dark black button-down shirt, is positioned in front of a night cityscape featuring the illuminated Taipei 101 tower. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his speech. (3) A close-up shot transitions to a small, brownish caterpillar covered in various insect parts and debris, crawling on a twig. The text '2x speed' appears in the upper left corner. (4) The camera returns to the male host, who continues to speak and gesture expressively against the city background. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 屍塊變潮牌？毛毛蟲的生存穿搭法. [Subtitle]: 雖然我很努力在跟流行了. (2) [Subtitle]: 高雄市廣告我可以理解. [Variety]: 高雄FUN過我. (3) [Subtitle]: 但有一個我真的不是很懂. (4) [Subtitle]: 就是把昆蟲屍體當成裝扮的. (5) [Subtitle]: 牠. (6) [Subtitle]: 夏威夷科學家新發現了這種超詭異的毛毛蟲. [Variety]: 2x speed. [Logo]: source: University of Hawaii at Manoa, CTAHR. (7) [Subtitle]: 牠住在蜘蛛網裡. (8) [Subtitle]: 會把蜘蛛吃剩的獵物肢體當裝飾品. (9) [Subtitle]: 像是蒼蠅的翅膀、象鼻蟲的頭. (10) [Subtitle]: 蠼螋的腹部啊等等. (11) [Subtitle]: 黏在自己的外殼上. (12) [Subtitle]: 實在是太殘忍、太變態了. (13) [Subtitle]: 跟人類好像. (14) [Subtitle]: 話說這種毛毛蟲特別罕見. (15) [Subtitle]: 因為牠屬於鱗翅目. (16) [Subtitle]: 也就是蛾跟蝶的幼蟲. (17) [Subtitle]: 但全球將近 20 萬種鱗翅目中. (18) [Subtitle]: 只有千分之一是肉食的. (19) [Subtitle]: 牠就是其中之一. (20) [Subtitle]: 這被科學家稱為人骨拼圖的毛毛蟲. (21) [Subtitle]: 該說很勇敢嗎. (22) [Subtitle]: 牠會咬破蜘蛛絲. (23) [Subtitle]: 去撿現成的昆蟲便當. (24) [Subtitle]: 剩菜的剩菜呢就裝飾在自己身上. (25) [Subtitle]: 多虧有這副裝扮. (26) [Subtitle]: 讓牠可以順利混在蜘蛛網裡不被發現. (27) [Subtitle]: 就連我們人類也是最近才注意到牠的存在. (28) [Subtitle]: 而牠長大後會長這樣. [Logo]: source: University of Hawaii at Manoa, CTAHR. (29) [Subtitle]: 只有一公分大. (30) [Subtitle]: 非常樸素. (31) [Subtitle]: 不過這種毛毛蟲目前只有在夏威夷歐胡島. (32) [Subtitle]: 一處小範圍森林裡生存. (33) [Subtitle]: 極為珍稀. (34) [Subtitle]: 果然勇敢的人先享受世界. (35) [Subtitle]: 但勇敢的人也很少. (36) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎. (37) [Subtitle]: 快點這裡. [Variety]: 快留言許願 下週《泛科學NEWS》就來報！
